title: Panchalankurichi
desc: Raised under Mayandi's roof, Kittan finds himself at odds with the family's rival, Kali. However, a budding romance threatens to complicate matters further.

title: Vanaja Girija
desc: Sisters Vanaja and Girija believe they were abandoned by their father due to the influence of a man named Ramanathan. The duo vow to alienate Ramanathan from his family as he did to theirs.

title: Poruthathu Pothum
desc: A lawyer locks horns with a police officer who is responsible for his mother's death. Later, he gets imprisoned due to a false accusation and reunites with his estranged father in prison.

title: Pettikadai
desc: A young doctor decides to help the small traders of a village who are financially affected by the presence of an online supermarket.

title: Attagasam
desc: Jeeva and Guru are twins who get separated in childhood by their mother in order to save their lives. When they reunite several years later, Guru swaps places with Jeeva.
